blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The "AI revolution" has enabled teams across the technology industry to deliver software features at unprecedented velocity. While code evolves faster than ever, customer-facing documentation often struggles to stay up to speed. As users increasingly rely on LLM-based agents that consume documentation as their primary interface, the impact of this documentation gap worsens: stale information propagates and is treated as authoritative. Signals for identifying where documentation has fallen behind already exist in abundance, both explicit (e.g., resolved support tickets revealing what documentation lacks) and implicit (e.g., code-documentation discrepancies detectable from automated loops). We deploy a multi-agent system, built around a triage agent we call "TriAgent," that continuously extracts these signals and repairs documentation drift. Over 43 days of shadow-mode operation, our system triaged 499 tickets and surfaced 92 gaps in the documentation. Using a panel of LLM judges from independent model families, 81.1% of TriAgent's verifiable assertions were correct (245 of the 302 assertions the human resolution addresses; majority of three judges); on length-comparable pairs the panel preferred TriAgent's response in 70.5% of pairs and the human engineer's in 23.2% (the rest had no judge majority). Importantly, agent- and human-sourced replies tended to be complementary, with the human often surfacing insights that were either buried within the existing documentation or missing from it entirely; our system turns each such insight into a documentation gap and, after human review, a fix. Repairing a gap measurably improved the agent's later answer: when the agent re-answered the same ticket after the repair, blinded judges preferred the post-repair answer over its own pre-repair answer 71.4% of the time (n=35). A blinded human audit confirms strong alignment on self-improvement.
blocks.zh: "AI革命"使整个技术行业的团队能够以前所未有的速度提供软件特征. 虽然代码的进取速度比任何时候都快,但客户化的文件往往难以跟上速度. 由于用户越来越多地依赖以LLM为基础的代理人,使用文件作为其主要接口,这种文件空白的影响会恶化:陈旧的信息传播,并被视为权威信息。 用于确定文件落后之处的信号已经大量存在,既包括明示的(例如,显示文件所缺乏内容的已解决的支持票),也包括默示的(例如,从自动循环中可探测出代码-文件差异)。 我们部署一个多剂系统, 围绕一个我们称之为"三剂"的分解剂, 它不断地提取这些信号和修复文件漂移。 在43天的影子模式操作中,我们的系统对499张门票进行了三分校对,并在文档中出现了92个空白. 利用独立模范家庭的LLM法官小组,三律师可核实的断言中有81.1%是正确的(302个断言中的245个是人的决议地址;3个法官的大多数);在长度相仿的对子上,三律师小组倾向于70.5%的对子和23.2%的人力工程师(其余没有法官多数)。 重要的是,代理人和人为来源的答复往往是相辅相成的,人们常常露出洞察力,这些洞察力要么埋藏在现有的文件中,要么完全从中缺失;我们的系统将每个洞会变成一个文件空白,在经过人文审查后,变成一个固定点。 修补漏洞可以衡量地改进了代理商后来的回答:当代理商在修补后重新回答同一张罚单时,失明的法官更喜欢修补后的回答,而不是自己在修补前的回答时间的71.4%(n=35). 盲目的人的审计证实了对自我改进的强烈一致。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Most teams in large technology companies have adopted AI-driven development practices that dramatically accelerate the rate at which the codebases powering the services they own change ( Peng et al. 2023 ) :
features that previously required weeks of engineering effort now reach production in days.
Ensuring that code obtained via AI-driven development meets the same standards as human development is a well-understood priority.
Yet as code delivery accelerates, customer-facing documentation often risks falling behind. And, absent an explicit mechanism, this gap is likely to be left unaddressed and grow over time.
blocks.zh:
大科技公司的大多数团队都采用了AI驱动的开发做法,大大加快了代码库为自身变化的服务提供动力的速度(Peng等人,2023年) :
以前需要数周工程努力的特性现在已用几天时间生产。
确保通过AI驱动的发展获得的代码符合与人类发展相同的标准,是众所周知的优先事项。
然而,随着代码传送的加速,客户文件往往有落在后面的风险。 而且,如果没有明确的机制,这一差距很可能得不到解决,并随着时间的推移而扩大。

blocks.en:
Risks related to stale documentation compound, as LLMs are ubiquitous across code development and in how users consume services: documentation is the primary entry point for both human users and their LLM-based tools.
On paper, this creates a strong incentive for service teams to maintain accurate, exhaustive documentation, and to offer a specialized support agent constrained to authoritative sources they control.
When documentation is exhaustive, such agents are more likely to provide accurate answers to service inquiries than a custom agent executed by a customer of the service, precisely because these agents can be built so as to be constrained to authoritative, curated sources.
Yet this opportunity is, in our experience, widely under-appreciated in practice: documentation is maintained reactively, in isolation, and without standard practices.
In this paper, we argue that even when the in-house agent cannot answer accurately, the attempt is still worthwhile: the failure itself is a signal that reveals where documentation falls short, and a system built to extract and act on that signal can continuously close the gap.
To explain the problem, and our solution, we consider three customer contacts of escalating difficulty in the context of a production support queue for a large A/B testing service.
blocks.zh:
与过时文件复合体有关的风险,因为LLMS在代码开发以及用户如何消费服务方面无处不在:文件是人类用户及其基于LLM的工具的主要切入点.
从纸面上讲,这为服务小组保持准确、详尽的文件记录提供了强有力的动力,并为他们控制的权威来源提供了专门的支持机构。
在文件详尽无遗的情况下,与服务客户执行的定制代理相比,此类代理商更有可能对服务查询提供准确的答案,正是因为这些代理商可以建立起来,以便受权威的、管理性来源的约束。
然而,根据我们的经验,这一机会在实践中被广泛低估:文件是被动、孤立和没有标准做法的。
在本文中,我们争辩说,即使内部代理人无法准确回答,但尝试还是值得的:失败本身是一个显示文件不足之处的信号,一个用来提取和根据该信号采取行动的系统能够不断缩小差距。
为了解释问题和我们的解决办法,我们考虑在大型A/B测试服务生产支持排队的情况下,三个客户接触不断升级的困难。

blocks.en:
The first case is a customer contact with a routine question.
A user reports that their experiment shows zero traffic before a certain date and asks whether this is a bug.
An agent consulting the service’s documentation identifies the cause immediately: the experiment was configured with a gradual ramp schedule.
The date in question is when traffic allocation began, not when the experiment was created.
This answer, grounded entirely in existing documentation, is identical to what the human responder provides.
The documentation is sufficient. The system effectively replaces the oncall duty a human engineer would have otherwise attended, automating and streamlining the process.
blocks.zh:
第一起案子是客户联系 例行提问
一个用户报告说,他们的实验显示在某个日期之前零流量,并询问这是否是一个错误.
一名代理人查阅服务的文件,立即查明原因:试验配置为逐步坡道时间表。
所涉及的日期是交通分配开始的时间,而不是实验创建的时间.
这个完全以现有文件为依据的答案与人类反应者提供的内容相同。
这些文件已经足够。 该系统有效地取代了人类工程师本来可以参加的待命职责,使程序自动化和精简。

blocks.en:
In a second question from the same queue, a user reports that a long-running analysis job disappeared from the portal.
The agent, drawing on the same documentation, suggests plausible explanations: the job may have been superseded by an automated pipeline, or it may be hidden in the default view.
The human responder, however, identifies the actual cause: a scheduled infrastructure patch reset the computation host mid-job, and the restarted job faces a runtime limit not documented anywhere.
The agent’s answer is coherent and grounded, but wrong.
Comparing the agentic and human responses directly reveals what the documentation lacks, without requiring any manual annotation or audit.
This case is addressable with human-in-the-loop supervision at the point of customer contact: the human corrects the agent’s response, and the divergence signals a documentation gap.
The system does not perform root-cause analysis: it simply extracts the output of the human reasoning.
Once documented, the agent can handle the same symptom correctly.
blocks.zh:
在同一个队列的第二个问题中,一个用户报告说,一个长期的分析工作从门户网站上消失了.
代理商根据同样的文件,提出了合理的解释:该工作可能已被自动管道取代,或者可能隐藏在默认视图中。
然而,人类应答者识别出实际原因:一个预定的基础设施补丁重置了计算主机的中场工作,重启的工作面临一个没有记录的运行时间限制.
代理人的回答是连贯和有根据的,但是错误的。
比较代理人和人的答复直接揭示了文件缺乏的内容,不需要任何人工说明或审计。
这一案件在客户接触点可以由人监督处理:人纠正代理人的反应,分歧表明文件空白。
系统不进行根因分析:它只是提取人类推理的输出.
一旦有记录,毒剂就可以正确处理同样的症状.

blocks.en:
The hardest case for our setting is one where a code change alters system behavior, but no user happens to ask about it and no human corrects an agent.
In this case, the documentation quietly falls out of sync with production.
This latent drift accumulates until it surfaces as a customer-facing failure, or worse, as a quietly incorrect agent response that no one challenges.
It is only addressable if an end-to-end system tracks code development and proactively surfaces documentation that has fallen behind.
blocks.zh:
我们设置最困难的情况是 代码更改改变系统的行为, 但是没有用户碰巧问起它, 没有人纠正一个代理。
在这种情况下,文件与制作之间没有同步。
这种潜伏的漂移会不断累积,直到它浮现成一种针对客户的失败,或者更糟糕的是,作为无人质疑的悄悄不正确的代理反应.
只有端到端的系统跟踪代码的开发并主动浮出已落后的文档,才具有可处理性.

blocks.en:
Motivated by these three examples, we argue that the same standards and continuous pipelines that govern code delivery must extend to the documentation that describes it.
To fill this gap, we deploy a multi-agent system that automates support responses and continuously repairs the documentation gaps they expose, both visible gaps revealed by human corrections and latent gaps where code outpaces documentation.
Over 43 days of production (shadow-mode) deployment on the service’s support queue, our system triaged 499 tickets and discovered 92 documentation gaps.
We employed LLM-as-a-judge evaluation of the agentic replies, using three judges from independent model families (see Section 3 for more details).
We extracted 1121 factual assertions from 192 agent responses. The human resolution addresses 302 of them, and 245 of those (81.1%) were confirmed correct. Most of the remaining assertions are not addressed by the human reply and cannot be checked against it. The errors that remain predominantly involve operational specifics absent from documentation.
On length-comparable ticket pairs the LLM judges preferred the agent’s documentation-grounded response over the human in 70.5% of cases.
Human responses were preferred in 23.2% of cases (the rest had no judge majority).
Importantly for our system, agent and human each raised correct points the other missed; where the human is preferred, their operational additions surface actionable gap signals that feed back into the maintenance loop.
Repairing a gap, in turn, measurably improved the agent’s later answer: when the agent re-answered the same ticket after the repair, the post-repair answer was preferred over its own pre-repair answer in 71.4% of blinded comparisons (74.3% in a blinded human audit of the same 35 pairs).
blocks.zh:
基于这三个例子,我们主张,规范代码交付的同样标准和连续管道必须延伸到描述它的文件。
为了填补这一空白,我们部署了一个多代理系统,该系统将支持答复自动化,并不断修复它们所暴露的文件空白,这既包括人为矫正所揭示的明显空白,也包括代码比文件速度快的潜在空白。
超过43天的制作(Shadow-mode)部署在服务的支持队列上,我们的系统对499张门票进行了剪切,并发现了92个文件空白.
我们使用LLM-as-a-judge对代理答复的评价,使用来自独立模范家庭的三名法官(详见第3节)。
我们从192个代理人的答复中提取了1121条事实指控。 人类决议涉及其中的302项,其中245项(81.1%)被证实是正确的。 其余的指称大多没有经过人的答复,无法加以核实。 仍然存在的错误主要涉及文件没有列出的业务细节。
在长度可比较的票对上,LLM评委更倾向于在70.5%的案件中以文件为依据的代理人的回应,而不是人的回应。
在23.2%的案件(其余的案件没有法官占多数)中,人们更愿意做出回应。
对我们的系统来说,代理人和人类都提出了错的点;在偏爱人类的地方,他们的操作增加了表面可操作的空隙信号,反馈到维护循环中。
修复漏洞反过来又大大改善了代理商后来的答案:当代理商在修复后重新回答同样的罚单时,在71.4%的盲目比较中,修复后的答案比其自身的修复前答案更受青睐(在对同一35对的盲目人审计中为74.3%).

blocks.en:
We make three contributions.
First, we reframe documentation maintenance as an inference problem: resolved support tickets are implicit supervision. The discrepancy between what the documentation provides and what a human responder supplies is itself the gap signal, and it costs nothing to collect.
Second, we build and deploy a multi-agent system that acts on this signal, detecting gaps from human corrections, proactive probing, and code–documentation drift, and drafting fixes that a human reviews before merge.
Third, we report a 43-day production deployment—measuring factual accuracy and agent–human agreement, and distilling the operational lessons of running the loop, including where it is throttled in practice.
blocks.zh:
我们作出了三项贡献。
首先,我们把文件维护重新确定为一个推断问题:解决的支持票是隐含的监督。 文件提供的内容与人类应答者供应的内容之间的差异本身就是差距信号,收集起来并不费钱。
其次,我们构建并部署一个多代理系统,在这个信号上发挥作用,发现人类矫正、主动探查和代码漂移的漏洞,并在合并之前起草人文审查的解决方案。
第三,我们报告43天的生产部署——衡量事实准确性和代理人——人类协议,并提炼运行循环的操作经验,包括实际运行过程中的节奏。

blocks.en: 2 System
blocks.zh: 2 系统

blocks.en:
Motivated by the three scenarios of Section 1 , we propose a system that automates support responses and turns two signals into documentation fixes: whether each answer succeeds or fails (reactive), and code–documentation drift caught before any ticket is filed (proactive).
We organize it around two problems: detecting where documentation fails ( Section 2.1 ) and producing correct fixes ( Section 2.2 ).
Five agents coordinate through a shared backlog, the improvement tracker, following a multi-agent conversation pattern ( Wu et al. 2024 ) . Figure 1 shows the full signal flow.
blocks.zh:
基于第1节的三种设想,我们提议建立一个系统,将响应自动化,并将两个信号变成文件修正:每个回答是成功还是失败(反应),以及代码-文件漂移在提交任何罚单(主动)之前。
我们围绕两个问题来安排:发现文件失效的地方(第2.1节)和提出正确的纠正办法(第2.2节)。
5名特工通过共享积压,改进跟踪器进行协调,遵循多代理谈话模式(吴等人,2024年). 图1显示全信号流.

blocks.en: Figure 1: System architecture. Gap signal sources (top) feed the improvement tracker through deduplication. The Documentator (bottom) drains the tracker through a fixed pipeline with a blocking self-review gate. Red arrows show feedback loops: rewrite on self-review failure, and reconciliation from human merge back to the tracker.
blocks.zh: 图1:系统架构。 间隙信号源(顶部)通过分解给改进跟踪器提供反馈. 记录器(底部)将跟踪器排出一个固定的管道,并设有阻塞的自我审查门。 红箭显示反馈循环:在自我审查失败时重写,以及从人类合并回追踪器的调和.

blocks.en: Table 1: System agents. Stage indicates the agent’s role in the loop (triage, detection, or remediation). Mode indicates when it runs. Shared state is the integration layer; no agent calls another directly.
blocks.zh: 表1:系统代理人。 阶段表示该剂在循环(跟踪、检测或补救)中的作用。 模式表示运行时。 共享状态是集成层;没有代理直接调用另一个.

blocks.en:
To make the flow concrete, consider the disappeared-analysis-job ticket from Section 1 .
“ TriAgent ” drafts a documentation-grounded response and surfaces it to the on-call responder, who instead supplies the true cause: a host reset mid-job and an undocumented runtime limit.
The Feedback Loop agent compares the two responses, isolates the missing constraint, and writes a gap entry to the improvement tracker.
The Documentator later drains that entry—researching the target document, drafting a fix, passing it through self-review, and opening a code review that a human approves before merge.
Once merged, the same symptom is answerable from documentation alone.
blocks.zh:
为了把流动混凝土 考虑一下第1节的消失 -分析 -工作罚单
“三方代理人”起草一个基于文件的回复,并向待命回复者展示,后者提供真正的原因:一个东道主重新设置了中场工作和一个无记录的运行时限。
反馈循环代理比较了两个响应,隔离了缺失的制约,并写了一个漏洞条目到改进跟踪器.
记录员后来将这个条目排出——研究目标文件,起草一个固定文件,通过自我审查,并开启一个人类在合并前批准的代码审查.
一旦合并,仅凭文件就可回答同样的症状。

blocks.en: 2.1 Detecting Gaps
blocks.zh: 2.1 检测差距

blocks.en:
The first stage of the system revolves around learning about existing documentation gaps.
As per Section 1 , these gaps manifest in two modes: visibly, through support tickets that signal something is wrong; and invisibly, through silent divergence that no user reports.
We address both.
blocks.zh:
该系统的第一阶段围绕了解现有文件空白。
根据第1节,这些差距表现为两种模式:显而易见,通过显示有问题的支持票;以及无形的、没有用户报告的沉默分歧。
我们讨论两个。

blocks.en:
Sometimes, when the documentation describing the system is unclear or stale, users file “tickets” in a dedicated support queue (i.e., complaints or questions about the service).
In this case, the support queue can serve as a detection mechanism for the system.
To convert this signal into actionable gap detection, the system operates a live triage loop via TriAgent: when a ticket arrives, it drafts a proposed response using only documentation-grounded evidence.
This proposed response is surfaced to the on-call human who is responsible for resolving the ticket.
The human is de facto acting as a specialized judge.
If they approve the agent’s response – which is grounded exclusively in authoritative documentation – this provides evidence that existing documentation is sufficient for that class of question.
If instead the human provides a different response, this is evidence of a gap in authoritative documentation.
We close this gap by activating a “ Feedback Loop ” agent, which compares the two responses, identifies the missing knowledge, and writes a structured gap entry to the improvement tracker.
Both outcomes are informative: approval confirms coverage; divergence reveals gaps.
blocks.zh:
有时,当描述系统的文件不明确或僵化时,用户会将“tickets”填入一个专门的支持队列(即关于服务的投诉或问题).
在这种情况下,支持队列可以作为系统的检测机制.
为了将这个信号转换成可操作的漏洞检测,系统通过三Agent运行一个实时的分解循环:当一张票到来时,它只使用文件根据的证据起草一个拟议响应.
这一拟议对策是针对负责解决罚单的待命人员提出的。
人类事实上是作为专门法官行事的。
如果他们批准代理人的答复(完全以权威文件为依据),这就证明现有文件足以解决这类问题。
如果人类提供了不同的答复,这就是权威文件存在漏洞的证据。
我们通过启动一个“反馈循环”代理来弥补这一差距,该代理对两个答复进行比较,找出缺失的知识,并撰写一个结构化的漏洞条目,输入改进跟踪器。
这两项结果都提供了信息:核准确认覆盖面;差异揭示差距。

blocks.en:
This same mechanism extends backwards in time.
A “ Harvest ” mode, orchestrated by the “ Archivist ” agent, applies the identical blind-comparison procedure to tickets already resolved in the past, backfilling documentation gaps from historical support data without requiring any new human effort.
blocks.zh:
这一机制在时间上向后延伸。
由“档案员”代理策划的“收获”模式,对过去已经解决的罚单适用同样的盲目比较程序,从历史支持数据中补足文件空白,而不需要任何新的人力努力。

blocks.en:
Not all documentation failures generate tickets, particularly when LLM-based consumers form incorrect beliefs rather than escalating.
We address this through two mechanisms.
First, via a “ Student ” agent, whose goal is to stress-test documentation coverage by generating synthetic probes: questions on topics not yet seen in the support queue, surfacing coverage gaps before a user encounters them.
Second, a “ Code-Merge Watcher ”, a dedicated agent whose goal is to detect documentation drift at the source, monitors production code packages for merged changes, performs an inverse lookup from changed code to affected documentation through a code-to-documentation registry ( Appendix B ), and flags cases where documentation may have drifted as a result of a code change, catching gaps at merge time, before any user is affected.
This represents a shift from reactive gap detection to integration with the development process itself: rather than waiting for drift to surface through support tickets, the system intercepts documentation-affecting code changes at merge time and can initiate fixes before the change reaches users.
Gaps discovered through either mechanism are written to the same tracker as ticket-derived gaps, with no distinction in how they are prioritized or resolved.
blocks.zh:
并非所有文件的失败都会产生罚单,特别是在基于LLM的消费者形成不正确的信念而不是升级的情况下.
我们通过两种机制解决这一问题。
首先,通过“学生”代理,目的是通过生成合成探测器来测试文件覆盖面的压力测试:关于支助队列中尚未发现的专题的问题,在用户遇到这些专题之前就出现覆盖差距。
第二,“码-元监视器”是一个专门代理人,目的是在源代码上发现文件漂移,监测合并后的制作码包,通过编码到文件登记册(附录B)从更改的码到受影响的文件进行反向检查,并标出文件可能因代码变化而漂移的情况,在合并时抓住漏洞,以免任何用户受到影响。
这代表着从反应性漏洞检测到与开发过程本身的整合的转变:系统不是等待通过支持票漂浮到表面,而是在合并时拦截影响文件的代码更改,可以在更改到达用户之前启动修复.
通过任何一种机制发现的漏洞都写给与出票缺口相同的跟踪者,在如何确定或解决这些漏洞方面没有区别。

blocks.en: 2.2 Producing Fixes
blocks.zh: 2.2 生产设备

blocks.en:
The next logical step, after having surfaced gaps as described in Section 2.1 , is to resolve them.
All detection signals converge on the improvement tracker, a shared backlog that deduplicates and prioritizes gaps automatically.
blocks.zh:
如第2.1节所述,在出现差距后,下一个合乎逻辑的步骤是消除这些差距。
所有检测信号都汇合在改进跟踪器上,这是共享的积压,会自动疏解并排出漏洞.

blocks.en:
We resolve gaps via a dedicated “ Documentator ” agent that drains the improvement tracker, converting gap signals into reviewed documentation updates through a fixed pipeline.
This agent researches the target document, and drafts a fix matching the target format.
A natural concern is that AI-generated fixes may themselves contain errors.
We address this risk in two ways.
First, before any fix reaches a human reviewer, we gate it through a structured “ self-review ” that evaluates the draft against factual consistency and scientific rigor criteria.
Second, a human is always in the loop: every fix produced by the Documentator is submitted as a code review that requires explicit human approval before merging.
The human’s role shifts from author to reviewer – but the review authority remains with a person.
blocks.zh:
我们通过一个专用的“文件员”代理人解决差距,该代理人耗尽了改进跟踪仪,通过固定管道将差距信号转换成经过审查的文件更新。
这个代理研究目标文档,并起草一个匹配目标格式的固定文件.
一个自然的担心是AI产生的修正本身可能包含错误.
我们以两种方式应对这一风险。
首先,在任何固定办法到达人文审查员之前,我们通过结构化的“自我审查”加以提出,按照事实一致性和科学严格标准评价草案。
第二,人总是在循环中:由Documentator制作的每一个定格都是作为代码审查提交的,在合并前需要人的明确批准.
人类的角色从作者转变为审查者,但审查权仍由一个人承担。

blocks.en:
The system operates on internal support tickets that can contain customer identifiers and production details.
All processing runs inside the service team’s existing access-controlled environment, and the agents inherit the same authorization scope as the on-call engineers they assist; ticket content is not exported outside that boundary.
The examples and evaluation artifacts reported in this paper were reviewed to remove customer-identifying and service-confidential specifics.
blocks.zh:
该系统在内部支持票上运作,可以包含客户识别码和生产细节.
所有处理都在服务小组现有的出入控制环境中进行,代理商继承的授权范围与其协助的待命工程师相同;售票内容不出口到该边界之外。
审查了本文件中报告的例子和评价文物,删除了客户识别和服务保密的细节。

blocks.en: 3 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3 评价

blocks.en: We evaluate the deployed system in five parts: its operational scale, the factual correctness of its responses, their usefulness relative to human resolutions, whether repairing a gap measurably improves later answers, and whether the full loop beats plain retrieval. Results are drawn from a frozen 43-day pilot on a production support queue for a causal-inference (A/B testing) analysis service.
blocks.zh: 我们从五个方面评价所部署的系统:其业务规模、其反应的实际正确性、相对于人类决议的有用性、弥补差距是否可大大改进以后的答案,以及整个循环是否超越了简单的检索。 研究结果来自一个冻结的43天的生产支持排队试验,用于因果推断(A/B测试)分析服务。

blocks.en: All automated judgments use a panel of three judges drawn from different model families than the agent’s generation model (Model A); we report the majority verdict and inter-judge agreement (Fleiss’ κ \kappa ). We exclude same-family judges from the headline because prior work finds that a judge tends to favor outputs from its own family ( Spiliopoulou et al. 2025 ) . A fourth, same-family judge is run separately as a probe ( Section C.2 ). The 499 triaged tickets measure deployment scale and are a distinct population from the scored set. Quality is graded on the 192 pairs that received both an agent and a human response, after excluding purely operational requests (e.g., “clear caches”) and trivially short exchanges and dropping a handful of non-answers the agent correctly declined (full funnel in Section C.1 ).
blocks.zh: 所有自动化判决都使用一个由来自不同模范家庭的三名法官组成的合议庭,这与代理人的生成模式(模式A)不同;我们报告多数判决和法官之间的协议(Fleiss's $\kappa )。 我们把同一家庭的法官排除在标题之外,因为以前的工作发现,法官倾向于自己家庭的产出(Spiliopoulou等人,2025年)。 第四,同家同业法官作为调查者单独运作(C.2节)。 499张三进制票衡量部署规模,是与得分组合不同的人群. 在排除了纯粹的业务请求(例如“明确的缓存”)和略微短的交换,并放弃了少数未回答的代理正确拒绝(C.1节中全漏斗)之后,质量在接受代理和人的反应的192对代理上进行分级。

blocks.zh: 3.1 部署计量表

The proactive Code-Merge Watcher recorded no gaps in this window: it fires only at code-merge time and its reach is bounded by the code-to-documentation registry (see Limitations). The agent drafts a candidate fix in under five minutes. A human reviews every draft before it merges. The tracker marks all 92 gaps as fixed, most of them in a single batch at the end of the window; 7 carry a gap-tagged commit in the documentation history.
blocks.zh: 表2总结了试点情况。 该系统对499张门票进行了三分,并出现了92个文件空白(附录A按机制分列)。 积极主动的代码-Morge Watcher记录了这个窗口中没有漏洞:它只在出现代码时开火,其影响范围受代码对文件登记册(见限制)的约束。 代理起草一个候选人 在五分钟内固定。 在合并之前,每个草案都要经过人类审查。 追踪器将所有92个缺口标记为固定的,其中大部分都是在窗口端一个批次;7个在文档历史中带有一个缺口标记的承诺.

blocks.en: 3.2 Factual Correctness
blocks.zh: 3.2 事实正确性

blocks.en:
We evaluate factual correctness at the assertion level with an automated pipeline that sits outside the deployed system, simply grading (and not producing) the agent’s answers. An LLM extraction pass identifies the factual claims in each TriAgent response; three LLM judges then label every claim independently against the human responder’s resolution (the single authoritative reference). We report their majority label.
We adopt a mutually-exclusive rule: a claim made by the TriAgent is incorrect if the human reference contradicts it, correct if the human reference addresses and supports it, and unverifiable if the human reference does not speak to it.
blocks.zh:
我们用一个位于部署系统之外的自动管道来评估断言层面的事实正确性,该管道只是对代理人的答案进行分级(而不是产生). 一份LLM提取证在每一份TriAgent回复中确定了事实索赔;三位LLM法官然后将每一项索赔分别标注在人类反应人的决议(单一权威参考)之下。 我们报告他们大多数的标签。
我们通过一条相互排斥的规则:如果人文参考与它相矛盾,则三方代理人提出的主张是不正确的;如果人文参考与它相矛盾,则正确无误;如果人文参考与它不符,则不可核实。

blocks.en:
From 192 responses we extracted 1121 assertions.
By majority the panel labels 245 correct, 57 incorrect, and 813 (72.5%) unverifiable.
On average, judges agree closely with one another (Fleiss’ κ = 0.73 \kappa=0.73{} , “substantial”), i.e. the verdicts do not hinge on any single model.
On 6 of the 1121 assertions the three judges split three ways (one correct, one incorrect, one unverifiable). These assertions are discarded for our evaluation.
We define accuracy as the fraction of assertions on which the TriAgent and the human agree. Because the human’s resolution is usually brief and answers only what was asked, much of what the agent adds is not mentioned in the human reply; we label these claims unverifiable , since the reference neither confirms nor contradicts them. We therefore report accuracy over the verifiable assertions, where it is 81.1% (245/302; Wilson 95% CI [76.3, 85.1], see Section C.1 ). If instead we count every unverifiable claim as an error, accuracy drops to 21.9%, though most such claims are probably fine. The firm number is the error floor: 57 of 1121 assertions (5.1%) directly contradicted the human.
The same-family probe is more decisive than the panel in both directions: it tags more assertions correct (279 vs. 245) and more incorrect (164 vs. 57; Section C.2 ).
blocks.zh:
我们从192份答复中提取了1121份断言。
多数情况下,面板标签为245正确、57不正确和813(72.5%)不可核实。
平均来说,法官们彼此意见一致(Fleiss ' ob = 0.73\kappa= 0.73}“实质”),即判决并不取决于任何单一的模式。
在1121年的断言中,有6起,3名法官分成了3个方面(一个正确、一个错误、一个无法核实)。 这些说法被弃于我们的评估。
我们把准确性定义为三方代理人和人类同意的说法的一小部分。 因为人类的解答通常很简短,只回答所问的问题,所以代理人补充的大部分内容在人类的解答中都没有提及;我们称这些主张是不可核实的,因为提法既不证实也不矛盾。 因此,我们报告可核实的说法的准确性,为81.1%(245/302;Wilson 95% CI[76.3, 85.1],见C.1节)。 如果我们将所有无法核实的索赔都算作一个错误,准确性降至21.9%,尽管大多数这类索赔可能都很好。 公司编号是错误底数:1121条断言中的57条(5.1%)直接与人类矛盾.
同一家庭的探测器比双向面板更具决定性:它标记的断言更正确(279对245),更不正确(164对57;C.2节)。

blocks.en: Each of the 57 contradicted assertions points to a specific place where the agent’s sources were wrong or incomplete, and each feeds back into the gap-detection loop. Validating the categorization of these errors against human labels is deferred to a human-audit round (see Limitations).
blocks.zh: 57项相互矛盾的断言都指出代理人的来源有误或不完整的特定地点,每一处都反馈到漏洞探测循环中。 对照人类标签验证这些错误的分类被推迟到人审计回合(见限制)。

blocks.en: 3.3 Usefulness
blocks.zh: 3.3 实用性

blocks.en: Table 3: Blinded pairwise preference (192 pairs, majority of three cross-family judges, κ = 0.41 \kappa=0.41{} ). The comparable-length column restricts to the 112 pairs whose two responses are within a 2 × 2\times length ratio.
blocks.zh: 表3:盲目双人偏好(192对,多数为三名跨家庭裁判,0.41\kappa=0.41###). 可比长的柱子限制在112对中,其两个响应在2×2\时间长度比内.

blocks.en: A correct answer is valuable only if it is also useful —one that actually resolves the customer’s ticket, at least as well as a human expert would. We measure this directly with blinded pairwise preference, scored by the same three-judge cross-family LLM panel: for each ticket, each judge sees the agent’s response and the human’s (order-counterbalanced, with the source hidden) and picks which one better resolves it, and we report the majority. Across all 192 pairs the agent is preferred on 150 (78.1%) and the human on 35 (18.2%). This raw figure is confounded by length: where the agent’s response is more than twice as long it is preferred in every case, and where it is much shorter the human wins. Restricting to length-comparable pairs (Table 3 ) the agent is still preferred 70.5% to 23.2% (95% CI on the former [61.5, 78.2])—so the preference is substantial but partly a verbosity effect.
blocks.zh: 一个正确的答案只有在同样有用的情况下才有价值——一个能够真正解决顾客的票,至少是一位人类专家会。 我们直接用盲目的双向偏好来衡量, 由同一三位法官的跨家庭LM面板评分:每张票,每个法官都看到代理人的反应和人类的反应(顺序对称, 在所有192对药物中,150对(78.1%)和35对(18.2%)的药物优先。 这个原始数字从长度上来说是令人困惑的:如果代理人的反应是每件案子的两倍多,而人类获胜的时间要短得多。 限于长度可比较的对(表3),该剂仍然倾向于70.5%至23.2%(前者为95%CI,[61.5,78.2])——所以偏好是实质性的,但部分是动词效应.

blocks.en: Beyond who is preferred, the agent and human responses are largely complementary: judged on coverage rather than winner, the agent raises a correct, material point the human omits in 91.1% of pairs, and the human raises one the agent omits in 83.9%. The agent broadens coverage, while the human’s additions are typically operational knowledge—permissions, escalations, transient system state—absent from documentation. Each such human-added point is a documentation defect the system can localize and repair; the preference and coverage signals feed directly into the gap-detection loop of Section 2.1 .
blocks.zh: 除了谁更受青睐之外,代理人和人类的反应基本上是互补的:根据覆盖范围而不是赢家判断,代理人在91.1%的对子中提出了人类省略的正确,物质的点,而人类在83.9%中提出了代理人省略的一点. 代理人扩大了覆盖范围,而人类的附加物通常是业务知识 -- -- 允许、升级、瞬时系统状态 -- -- 不包括文件。 每个这样的加人点都是系统可以本地化和修复的文献缺陷;偏好和覆盖信号直接反馈到第2.1节的漏洞-探测循环中.

blocks.en: 3.4 Self-Improvement
blocks.zh: 3.4 自我改进

blocks.en:
We next test the system’s central claim: that fixing the documentation improves the quality of the replies the agent later produces.
For the 35 gaps where the agent’s original response was not high-confidence (its self-reported medium / low label)—the cases where improvement is a meaningful question—we compare that original answer with a later re-answer produced against the updated documentation. Both answers use the same agent (Model A), prompt, and ticket, with no access to the human resolution; only the retrieved documentation differs, isolating the fix as the cause of any improvement. Scoring is blinded: the judge sees the two answers without being told which came first, and reports which better resolves the ticket.
The later answer is preferred in 71.4% of cases and the earlier in 28.6% ( κ = 0.61 \kappa=0.61{} ; 95% CI on the 71.4%: [54.9, 83.7], n = 35 n=35{} ; corroborated by a blinded human audit, see Section 6 ).
blocks.zh:
我们接下来检验这个系统的中心主张:确定文件可以提高代理商后来作出的答复的质量。
对于代理人最初答复不是高度自信(其自报的中/低标签)的35个空白,即改进是一个有意义的问题的情况,我们将最初的答复与后来根据更新的文件作出的重新答复进行比较。 两种答案都使用相同的代理(Model A),即时,和罚单,不能访问人类的解析;只有检索到的文件不同,隔离固定作为任何改进的原因. Scoring是盲目的:法官在不被告知哪个答案是第一的情况下看到两个答案,
在71.4%的个案中倾向于采用后一种答案,而在28.6%的个案中倾向于采用前一种答案(ob = 0.61\kappa= 0.61{});在71.4%的个案中则采用95%的CI:[54.9, 83.7],n = 35n= 35{};经盲目的人类审计证实,见第6节.

blocks.en: A skeptic might object that the documentation was there all along, so the fix changed nothing. We rule this out via the edit history: for every tagged gap, the commit updating the relevant page postdates our flagging it, so the content that improved the second answer did not exist when the first was written.
blocks.zh: 怀疑者可能会反对文件一直存在,所以修补没有改变什么. 我们通过编辑历史排除了这一点:对于每个标注的空白,更新相关页面的承诺会给我们贴上标签的日期,所以改进第二个答案的内容在第一个答案被写入时并不存在。

blocks.en: 3.5 Is It More Than Retrieval?
blocks.zh: 3.5 它比检索还重要吗?

blocks.en: Finally, does the full agent pipeline earn its complexity over plain retrieve-and-generate? We build a retrieval-only baseline—BM25, a standard lexical ranking function ( Robertson and Zaragoza 2009 ) , over the same documentation corpus, feeding the top passages to the same generation model as the agent (Model A), with no gap detection, feedback, or self-improvement—and run the blinded pairwise comparison of Section 3.3 between the full agent’s deployed response and the baseline’s over the 192 pairs. The full system is preferred 64.6% of the time and the baseline 31.2% ( κ = 0.55 \kappa=0.55{} ). Both systems retrieve over the same documentation, which the loop had already improved. They differ in retrieval and orchestration. This comparison therefore measures the full answering pipeline against plain retrieval. The before/after comparison of Section 3.4 measures the maintenance loop itself, holding the pipeline fixed and changing only the documentation.
blocks.zh: 最后,完整的代理管道是否通过纯回收和基因获得其复杂性? 我们构建了一个仅检索的基线-BM25,一个标准词汇排名函数(Robertson和Zaragoza,2009年),在同一文献资料库上,将顶端的通道输入到与物剂相同的一代模型(A模式),没有漏洞检测、反馈或自我改进——并运行第3.3节的盲目双向比较,将全物剂部署的响应与基线比对192对。 整个系统优先时间为64.6%,基准时间为31.2%(=0.55\kappa=0.55\ )。 这两个系统都从同样的文件上检索到,环路已经改进。 它们在检索和整理方面有所不同。 因此,这一比较衡量了整个答复程序与普通检索之间的对比。 在比较第3.4节之前/之后,对维护环路本身进行测量,固定管道,只更改文件。

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en:
Deploying large language models for operational support is increasingly common, from root cause analysis of cloud incidents ( Chen et al. 2024 ; Zhang et al. 2024 ) to autonomous multi-step diagnosis ( Wang et al. 2024 ; Roy et al. 2024 ) and design frameworks for autonomous cloud operations ( Shetty et al. 2024 ; Chen et al. 2025 ) .
These systems retrieve from documentation or knowledge bases via retrieval-augmented generation ( Lewis et al. 2020 ; Guu et al. 2020 ) , but uniformly treat the knowledge base as a static input. When documentation is incomplete or stale, the system degrades silently. Our work addresses this assumption: we close the loop so that operation itself repairs the knowledge base it depends on.
blocks.zh:
从对云层事件的根本原因分析来看,为业务支助部署大型语言模型越来越普遍(Chen等人)。 2024; 张等 2024)到自主多步骤诊断(王等 2024; 罗伊等 2024)和自主云操作设计框架(Shetty et al. 2024; 陈等 2025).
这些系统通过检索生成从文件或知识库中检索(Lewis et al. 2020; Guu等人 2020),但统一将知识库视为静态输入. 当文档不完整或陈旧时,系统会无声地退化. 我们的工作涉及这个假设:我们关闭循环,以便行动本身修复它所依赖的知识基础。

blocks.en: Self-improving agents could in principle address this gap. Reflexion ( Shinn et al. 2023 ) and Self-Refine ( Madaan et al. 2023 ) demonstrate that self-critique improves task performance, and SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al. 2024 ) applies agents to code repair. However, these approaches rely on automated correctness oracles (test suites, execution traces) that documentation lacks. Our self-review shares the critique-then-revise structure but substitutes human review as the terminal authority.
blocks.zh: 自我改进的代理人原则上可以弥补这一差距。 Reflexion (Shinn等人,2023年)和self-Refine (Madaan等人,2023年)表明,自律能改善任务性能,SWE-bench(Jimenez等人,2024年)对代码修补应用剂. 然而,这些方法依赖于缺乏文件的自动正确性预告(测试套件,执行痕迹). 我们的自我检讨同意当时的检讨结构,

blocks.en: Documentation staleness is a well-documented problem in software engineering ( Aghajani et al. 2019 ) , but prior automated solutions focus on code-comment synchronization or API-doc generation from source ( Panthaplackel et al. 2020 ; Mastropaolo et al. 2021 ) , where static analysis can detect drift between code and its inline annotations. Our work tackles a different problem: maintaining human-authored knowledge bases describing system behavior, operational procedures, and troubleshooting guidance. These artifacts drift from production reality in ways no static analysis can catch, because the gap is between what the system does and what prose says it does. Two concurrent 2026 systems target documentation maintenance directly: DocSync ( Badrinarayan and Parthasarathy 2026 ) runs a critic-guided reflexion loop grounded in source-code structure, and ArtifactSync ( Alor et al. 2026 ) performs commit-level change-impact analysis. Both are code-change driven —they detect drift by inspecting source and diffs. Our Code-Merge Watcher ( Section 2.1 ) works the same way. Our ticket-derived signal is orthogonal and complementary: the delta between an agent’s documentation-grounded answer and the human resolution surfaces where documentation fails users , not where it diverges from code . A code-diff method cannot flag a document whose underlying code never changed but which users repeatedly misunderstand; ticket-derived implicit supervision can. More broadly, learning from implicit human feedback is well-studied in information retrieval ( Joachims et al. 2005 ) and language model alignment ( Ouyang et al. 2022 ) ; to our knowledge, this operational-feedback signal has not previously been operationalized for documentation maintenance.
blocks.zh: 文件呆滞是软件工程(Aghajani等人,2019年)中一个有详细记载的问题,但之前的自动化解决方案侧重于代码同步或API-doc生成源(Panthaplackel等人. 2020; Mastropaolo 等人 2021),其中静态分析可以检测代码与其内含说明之间的漂移. 我们的工作解决了一个不同的问题:维持由人类授权的知识库,描述系统行为、操作程序和解决问题的指导。 这些文物从生产现实中漂移,没有静态分析能够捕捉到,因为差距在于系统所做的事和传言所说的话. 两个并行的2026系统直接针对文件维护:DocSync(Badrinarayan和Parthasaratithy 2026)运行一个基于源代码结构的批评者制导反射循环,ArtifactSync(Alor等人,2026)进行承诺级变化影响分析. 两者都是由代码更改驱动的——它们通过检查源头和diffs来检测漂移. 我们的代码-监视器(第2.1节)同样起作用。 我们的门票信号是正交的和互补的:从一个代理的基于文件的答案到人类解析度之间的三角洲表面显示的是文件的失败用户,而不是它偏离代码的地方。 代码diff法不能标出其基本代码从未改变过但用户反复误解的文档;出票隐含监管可以. 更广泛地说,在信息检索(Joachims等人,2005年)和语言模型对齐(Ouyang等人,2022年)方面,对从隐含的人类反馈中学习进行了很好的研究;据我们所知,这一业务反馈信号以前没有用于文件维护。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
Documentation maintenance is usually framed as an authoring problem. We reframe it as continuous inference: resolved support tickets are implicit supervision, and the delta between what documentation says and what a human actually needed is a gap signal requiring no annotation.
We built a deployed system that exploits this signal. Over 43 days, it triaged 499 tickets and discovered 92 documentation gaps. Of the 302 agent assertions that the human resolution addresses, 81.1% were correct (Fleiss’ κ = 0.73 \kappa=0.73{} ). A blinded human audit most strongly corroborates the before/after self-improvement result ( κ = 0.68 \kappa=0.68{} ); it endorses the offline correctness and usefulness rates only fairly, so we read those as panel-internal estimates (see Limitations).
blocks.zh:
文件维护通常被设定为编写问题. 我们把它重新描绘成连续的推论: 解决的支持票是隐含的监管, 和三角洲之间 的文件所言和人类实际需要的 是一个不需要注释的空白信号。
我们建立了利用这个信号的部署系统。 在43天的时间里,它分了499张票,并发现了92个文件空白. 在302名代理人声称人类分辨率地址中,81.1%是正确的(Fleiss's $ = 0.73\kappa= 0.73= )。 盲目的人力审计最有力地证实了自我改进结果之前/之后(=0.68\kappa=0.68=0.68=0.68=0.68),它只公平地认可离线正确性和实用性率,所以我们把这些看作是小组内部的估计(见限制)。

blocks.en: We view our main contribution as proposing documentation maintenance as an inference problem. With this angle, resolved support tickets become a continuous, freely available supervision signal for closing documentation drift. Across 192 blinded comparisons the agent’s response was preferred to the human’s on length-comparable pairs (70.5%), each response surfaced correct points the other missed, and repairing a gap measurably improved the agent’s later answer (71.4% preferred, blinded); each ticket where the human responder added value simultaneously generated an actionable gap signal, requiring no annotation, no audit, and no manual triage.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,我们的主要贡献是提议维持文件是一个推断问题。 有了这一角度,解决的支持票就成为关闭文件漂移的连续、免费的监督信号。 在192个盲目比较中,特警的反应比人类的长比对(70.5 % ) 更受青睐,每一次反应都浮出另一个错失的正确点,并修复一个缺口大大改善了特警后来的回答(71.4 % 偏好,失明);每张罚单中,特警的附加值同时产生一个可操作的缺口信号,不需要注释、审计和手动分辨。

blocks.en:
Beyond repair, the same signal informs prevention. Patterns in resolved tickets reveal which documentation structures prevent user confusion and which generate it. A team deploying a new feature can consult this signal to write effective documentation from day one, so the loop reaches from past drift to current fixes, and from past failures to future design.
While we evaluate on a single service, the underlying signal —resolved tickets as implicit supervision—applies to any service with a documentation-backed support queue where humans correct or supplement automated responses. The specific detection heuristics, gap taxonomy, and fix pipeline would, however, require adaptation to a new domain; we do not claim the design choices transfer unchanged (see Section 6 ).
The path to full deployment is incremental: widening from shadow-mode triage toward human-gated live responses, and from the pilot’s batch merges toward rolling, per-gap repair.
See the appendices for details.
blocks.zh:
除了修复以外,同样的信号也为预防提供了信息。 已解决罚单的图案显示哪些文件结构可以防止用户混淆,哪些文件会引起混乱。 部署新功能的团队可以查询这个信号,从第一天开始写出有效的文件,所以循环从过去的漂移到目前的修正,从过去的失败到未来的设计.
虽然我们评价的是单一服务,但基本的信号——作为隐含监督的解票——适用于任何具有文件支持的支持队列的服务,即人类纠正或补充自动响应。 然而,具体的检测热度、差距分类和固定管道需要适应一个新的领域;我们并不声称设计选择转移没有改变(见第6节)。
全面部署的路径是渐进的:从影子模式分解到人类的现场反应,从飞行员的批次合并到滚动的、每轮修复。
详见附录。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en: We flag five limitations of this pilot.
blocks.zh: 我们标出了这飞行员的五个限制。

blocks.en: Single deployment context. We have evaluated the system exclusively on one service’s support queue—a causal-inference service with a technically sophisticated user base and well-structured documentation. The architecture is domain-agnostic in principle, but services with different characteristics (higher ticket volume, less structured knowledge bases, non-technical end users, or fundamentally different failure modes) may require different detection heuristics, gap taxonomies, or fix pipelines.
blocks.zh: 单一部署背景。 我们只根据一个服务处的支助队列来评价这个系统 -- -- 这种因果推断服务具有技术先进的用户基础和结构良好的文件。 架构原则上是域不可知的,但具有不同特征(票量较高,结构较少的知识库,非技术性终端用户,或根本不同的故障模式)的服务可能需要不同的检测heuristics,差距分类法,或固定管道.

blocks.en: Evaluation methodology. Correctness, preference, and before/after improvement are scored by a panel of three judges from different model families than the generation model, by majority vote with Fleiss’ κ \kappa . A fourth, same-family judge is kept out of the headline as a precaution against the family favoritism reported by Spiliopoulou et al. (2025) ; its verdicts differ from the panel’s in both directions ( Section C.2 ). To check the panel against human judgment, one author re-labeled a blinded, stratified subsample of the frozen decisions (51 correctness assertions, 30 usefulness pairs, 35 before/after pairs), blind to the panel verdict and to which response was the agent’s. Agreement is substantial on the before/after judgments that carry our central self-improvement claim (Cohen’s κ = 0.68 \kappa=0.68{} , 83% raw) and fair on correctness and usefulness ( κ ≈ 0.30 \kappa\approx 0.30{} ); the annotator simply tied more readily and read correctness more leniently than the panel. We therefore treat the self-improvement result as human-validated and the offline correctness and usefulness rates as panel-internal estimates. With a single annotator these rates remain observational, and a larger multi-annotator audit is future work. The before/after set is selected: it covers the 35 repaired gaps whose earlier answer was stored and not high-confidence, and it re-answers only the triggering ticket. Improvement on new related tickets is not yet measured. Pairwise preference is partly confounded by response length, which we mitigate by reporting the length-comparable subset alongside the full set.
blocks.zh: 评价方法。 由三位来自不同模范家庭的评委组成, 第四,同家同业法官被置于头条之外,以防范Spiliopoulou等人(2025年)报告的家庭恩怨;其判决与陪审团的两条方向不同(C.2节)。 为了对照人类的判断来检查小组,一位作者重新给一个被蒙蔽的、分级的冻结决定的子样本贴上标签(51项正确性断言,30项实用性对,35项前后对),无视小组的裁决,而代理人对此的回应是否定的。 在判决之前/之后, 提出我们中央自我改进要求(Cohen's $ = 0.68\kappa = 0.68\ , 83% 原始), 以及正确性和实用性( $ 0. 30\kappa\ , 大约 0. 30\ ) 的公平性, 因此,我们把自我改进的结果作为人类验证的结果,把离线的正确性和有用性率作为小组内部的估计。 有了单一的注释员,这些比率仍然是观察性的,而更大的多注释员审计是今后的工作。 选择了前/后设定:它覆盖了35个修复的漏洞,之前的答案被存储,而不是高度自信,它只重新回答触发门票. 新的相关罚单的改进尚未衡量。 对等偏好因反应长度而部分令人困惑,我们通过报告与全套对应的长度子集来减轻这种困惑。

blocks.en: Operational boundary. In most tickets the human responder adds operational specifics (granting permissions, clearing caches, merging code) that the agent cannot perform from documentation alone; extending coverage would require tool-use capabilities beyond KB retrieval.
blocks.zh: 业务边界。 在大多数门票中,人类应答者会添加代理商单独无法从文档中执行的操作细节(授予权限,清除缓存,合并代码);扩展覆盖范围需要超过KB检索的工具使用能力.

blocks.en: Human in the loop. In our system, we require human review of every documentation change the agent proposes before it merges. This is a deliberate choice: the system is still maturing, and a wrong fix is costly because it becomes an authoritative answer for many downstream users and their agents. A person therefore remains the correctness and authority gate, with the agent shifting from author to reviewer. We did not measure the time reviewers spend inspecting, correcting, and merging drafts; the five-minute drafting time excludes it. Whether the loop saves human effort overall remains open.
blocks.zh: 人类在循环。 在我们的系统中,我们需要人审查 每一个文件 改变代理人建议 它合并。 这是一个刻意的选择:系统仍在成熟,错误的修复代价高昂,因为它成为许多下游用户及其代理人的权威答案. 因此,一个人仍然是正确性和权威的大门,代理人从作者转向审查者。 我们没有衡量审查人员花在检查、纠正和合并草案上的时间;5分钟的起草时间将其排除在外。 这一循环是否拯救了人类的整体努力,仍然开放。

blocks.en: Proactive detection coverage. The Code-Merge Watcher’s coverage depends on the completeness of the code-to-documentation registry; unmapped packages are invisible to it. The watcher recorded no gaps in the pilot window; prevention at merge time is not yet demonstrated.
blocks.zh: 主动检测覆盖. 代码-Morge Watcher的覆盖范围取决于代码到文件注册的完整性;未标记的软件包是隐形的. 监视器记录到试运行窗口没有缺口;合并时的预防尚未显示.

blocks.en: Appendix A Gap Type Taxonomy and Improvement Tracker
blocks.zh: 附录A 差距类型分类和改进跟踪

blocks.en: The improvement tracker is the shared data structure that connects gap detection ( Section 2.1 ) to gap remediation ( Section 2.2 ). Every gap entry records a structured lifecycle: discovery metadata (source mechanism, originating ticket, timestamp), a typed classification, a priority assignment, and resolution state. We describe the classification scheme and the lifecycle below.
blocks.zh: 改进跟踪仪是共享的数据结构,将差距探测(第2.1节)与差距补救(第2.2节)联系起来。 每个漏洞条目记录一个结构化的生命周期:发现元数据(来源机制,始发票,时间戳),打字分类,优先任务,以及解析状态. 我们描述分类计划和以下的生命周期。

blocks.en: A.1 Classification
blocks.zh: A.1 分类

blocks.en: Every gap discovered by the system is classified into one of five types (Table 4 ): missing (no documentation exists), stale (outdated behavior), contradictory (two sources conflict), ambiguous (underspecified), and broken_xref (dead or incorrect link).
blocks.zh: 系统发现的每一个漏洞都归为五种类型之一(表4):缺失(不存在文档), stale(过时行为),矛盾(两个来源冲突),模棱两可(未说明),以及break_xref(死或错链接).

blocks.en:
The type determines the remediation path.
Gaps of type missing are routed to a Gap-Filler pipeline that drafts new content from scratch using production source code as ground truth.
The remaining four types describe defects in existing documentation and are routed to a Stale-Updater pipeline that modifies the relevant section in place.
blocks.zh:
该类型决定了补救路径.
类型缺失的缺口被连接到一个Gap-Filler管道,该管道将生产源代码作为地面真理从头开始起草新的内容。
其余四类描述现有文件的缺陷,并经过Stale-Updater管道,该管道修改了现有相关部分。

blocks.en: Some tickets reveal a defect in the product rather than in its documentation. The triage step routes every ticket by topic to the owning engineering team, which receives product defects for a code fix. TriAgent records a gap only when the documentation itself falls short, and the agents never modify product code.
blocks.zh: 部分门票显示产品而非其文档存在缺陷. 分解步骤将每张票逐个题材向拥有的工程团队传递,后者接收产品缺陷用于代码固定. TriAgent只记录到文件本身不足时出现漏洞,代理商从来不修改产品代码.

blocks.en: Table 4: Gap type taxonomy. missing routes to Gap-Filler; the other four route to Stale-Updater.
blocks.zh: 表4:差距类型分类法。 缺少通往 Gap-Filler 的路线; 其它四个通往 Stale- Updater 的路线。

blocks.en: In our deployment, the vast majority of gaps ( > > 90%) are of type missing , reflecting that documentation absence—rather than staleness—is the primary failure mode for the service studied. This finding may not generalize: services with rapidly evolving configurations may see a higher proportion of stale gaps, while services with multiple documentation maintainers may encounter more contradictory cases.
blocks.zh: 在我们的部署中,绝大多数空白( > 90%以上)属于类型缺失,这反映出文件缺失——而不是停滞——是所研究的服务的主要故障模式。 这一结论可能无法概括:配置迅速变化的服务可能会发现较高比例的陈旧差距,而拥有多个文件维护者的服务可能会遇到更矛盾的情况。

blocks.en: A.2 Lifecycle
blocks.zh: A.2 生命周期

blocks.en: Each gap progresses through a fixed lifecycle:
blocks.zh: 每个差距都通过固定生命周期取得进展:

blocks.en: 1. Discovery. A detection mechanism ( Section 2.1 ) identifies a documentation deficiency and writes an entry to the tracker. The entry records the source mechanism, the originating ticket (if any), the gap type, a natural-language description of what is missing, and a suggested fix direction. 2. Prioritization. The system assigns a priority (high, medium, low) based on two signals: the number of distinct tickets in which the gap has surfaced (frequency count), and whether the gap caused an incorrect agent response. Gaps that recur across multiple tickets are prioritized higher. 3. Remediation. The Documentator agent ( Section 2.2 ) drains the tracker in priority order, drafting a fix for each gap. The fix passes through self-review and is submitted as a code review for human approval. 4. Closure. Once the human reviewer approves and merges the fix, the gap status transitions to fixed . Figure 2 shows the cumulative progression from discovery through closure over the deployment period.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 发现者. 检测机制(第2.1节)查明文件不足,并写入追踪器。 条目记录了源机制,原票(如果有的话),缺口类型,缺失内容的自然语言描述,以及建议的固定方向. 2. 确定优先次序。 系统根据两个信号分配优先级(高,中,低):空隙出现的不同门票数量(频率计数),空隙是否导致代理响应错误. 在多张罚单上重复出现的差距得到优先处理。 3. 补救。 记录员代理人(第2.2节)按优先顺序排出追踪器,为每个缺口起草一个固定装置。 固定通过自我审查,并作为守则审查提交供人类批准。 4. 结束。 一旦人文审查者批准和合并固定,差距状态就向固定状态过渡。 图2显示部署期间从发现到关闭的累积进展。

blocks.en: Discovery. A detection mechanism ( Section 2.1 ) identifies a documentation deficiency and writes an entry to the tracker. The entry records the source mechanism, the originating ticket (if any), the gap type, a natural-language description of what is missing, and a suggested fix direction.
blocks.zh: 发现者. 检测机制(第2.1节)查明文件不足,并写入追踪器。 条目记录了源机制,原票(如果有的话),缺口类型,缺失内容的自然语言描述,以及建议的固定方向.

blocks.en: Prioritization. The system assigns a priority (high, medium, low) based on two signals: the number of distinct tickets in which the gap has surfaced (frequency count), and whether the gap caused an incorrect agent response. Gaps that recur across multiple tickets are prioritized higher.
blocks.zh: 分清诸法. 系统根据两个信号分配优先级(高,中,低):空隙出现的不同门票数量(频率计数),空隙是否导致代理响应错误. 在多张罚单上重复出现的差距得到优先处理。

blocks.en: Remediation. The Documentator agent ( Section 2.2 ) drains the tracker in priority order, drafting a fix for each gap. The fix passes through self-review and is submitted as a code review for human approval.
blocks.zh: 补之. 记录员代理人(第2.2节)按优先顺序排出追踪器,为每个缺口起草一个固定装置。 固定通过自我审查,并作为守则审查提交供人类批准。

blocks.en: Closure. Once the human reviewer approves and merges the fix, the gap status transitions to fixed . Figure 2 shows the cumulative progression from discovery through closure over the deployment period.
blocks.zh: 关闭。 一旦人文审查者批准和合并固定,差距状态就向固定状态过渡。 图2显示部署期间从发现到关闭的累积进展。

blocks.en: When a detection mechanism identifies a gap that matches an existing tracker entry, no duplicate is created. Instead, the system increments the entry’s frequency count and appends the new ticket to its list of originating tickets. In our deployment, 11 gaps recurred across multiple tickets (frequency 2–4), and these recurring gaps were disproportionately classified as high priority—confirming that recurrence is a useful prioritization signal.
blocks.zh: 当检测机制确定一个匹配现有跟踪器条目的缺口时,不创建重复. 相反,系统会增加输入次数,并将新票附在其原票单上。 在我们的部署中,在多个门票(频率2-4)之间再次出现11个缺口,这些反复出现的缺口被不成比例地归类为高度优先——确认再次出现是一个有用的优先秩序信号。

blocks.en: Over the pilot, discovery was dominated by reactive harvesting of resolved tickets (34) and live triage (28), with smaller contributions from the Student’s on-demand probing (6) and the Feedback Loop (2); 21 gaps have no recorded detection source (a tracking-metadata omission) and one was logged manually. The proactive Code-Merge Watcher recorded none in-window ( Section 3.1 ). The tracker’s priority breakdown reflects the dominance of missing : because absent documentation affects every user who encounters the topic, these gaps tend to surface repeatedly and escalate in priority.
blocks.zh: 在试点期间,发现主要是被动地收获已解决的罚单(34张)和现场分拣(28张),学生点播调查(6)和反馈循环的贡献较小(2);21个缺口没有记录的检测来源(跟踪-元数据遗漏),一个缺口是人工记录的。 积极主动的《守则》监测员没有记录任何窗口(第3.1节)。 追踪器优先级的分解反映了缺失的主导地位:由于没有文件,每个遇到这个话题的用户都会受到影响,因此这些空白往往会反复出现,并在优先级上升级。

blocks.en: Appendix B Code-to-Documentation Registry
blocks.zh: 附录B 书记官处

blocks.en: The registry is a version-controlled JSON file that maps each documentation target to the code packages implementing what it describes. Each entry records the package, the role it plays for that document, and the reason the mapping exists. During the pilot it held 21 documentation targets, and a companion watchlist named 18 code packages from the service’s build pipeline. The Code-Merge Watcher ( Section 2.1 ) reads the registry in reverse. For each change merged into a watched package, it looks up the documents mapped to that package and asks an LLM judge whether the change makes any of them stale. A merged change in a package with no registry entry yields no candidate documents, which bounds the watcher’s coverage ( Section 6 ). The Documentator does not yet use the registry; fetching the implementing code at draft time is a planned extension.
blocks.zh: 登记册是一个版本控制的JSON文件,它将每个文件目标映射到执行它描述的代码包中. 每个条目记录软件包,它为文档发挥的作用,以及映射存在的原因. 在试点期间,它有21个文件目标,以及一个名为18个编码包的配套监视名单,来自服务处的建设管道。 《守则》监测员(第2.1节)对登记册进行反读。 对于每个更改合并成一个被监视的软件包,它查看了映射到该软件包的文档,并询问一个LLM判断器,这些更改是否使其中任何一个都僵化. 包件的合并改动,没有登记记录,不产生任何候选文件,这就限制了监视者的覆盖范围(第6节)。 文档员尚未使用登记册;在草稿时获取执行代码是计划延期。

blocks.en: Appendix C Evaluation Protocol Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 评价协议

blocks.en: This appendix details the protocol shared by the automated analyses—factual correctness ( Section 3.2 ), usefulness ( Section 3.3 ), and self-improvement ( Section 3.4 ); the deployment-scale metrics ( Section 3.1 ) are descriptive. Factual correctness asks whether individual claims in the agent’s responses are true; usefulness asks whether the overall response is competitive with the human’s; self-improvement asks whether repairing a gap improves the later answer. All three use the judge panel described below.
blocks.zh: 本附录详细列出了自动分析——事实正确性(第3.2节)、有用性(第3.3节)和自我改进(第3.4节)所共同使用的程序;部署尺度(第3.1节)是描述性的。 事实正确性询问代理人的回复中的个人诉求是否属实;有用性询问整体响应是否与人类竞争;自我改进询问弥补缺口是否改善后一个答案. 这三人都使用下文所述的法官小组。

blocks.en: C.1 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: C.1 数据集建设

blocks.en:
The evaluation dataset is drawn from a production support queue.
Of the 499 tickets TriAgent triaged during the pilot (its deployment scale), 333 received both an agent response and a recorded human resolution to the same ticket; the remaining triaged tickets lacked a comparable human answer to grade against and fall outside the scored set.
We begin from these 333 pairs, each containing the ticket (title and description), the agent’s documentation-grounded response, and the human responder’s resolution.
blocks.zh:
评价数据集来自生产支持队列。
在试播期间的499张票(其部署规模)中,有333张获得了代理响应,并记录了人类对同一张票的解析度;其余的3张票在分数上没有对应的人的解答度,落在得分组合之外.
我们从这333对开始,每对都包含着罚单(标题和描述),特工的文件依据反应,以及人类响应者的决心.

blocks.en: We apply two filters. First, we exclude mechanical tickets—requests that require only a rote action (e.g., “please clear caches for dataset X”) with no diagnostic reasoning. Second, we apply minimum length thresholds (agent response ≥ \geq 50 characters, human response ≥ \geq 20 characters) to remove cases where either party gave a trivially short acknowledgment rather than a substantive answer.
blocks.zh: 我们使用两个过滤器。 首先,我们排除了机械车票——仅要求转动的请求(例如, " 请为数据集X清除缓存 " ),没有诊断推理。 第二,我们采用最小长度阈值(代理答复 \ geq 50 个字符, 人的反应 \ \ geq 20 个字符)来删除任何一方给予微不足道的简短承认而不是实质性答复的案件。

blocks.en: After filtering, we further exclude seven non-answers—tickets the agent correctly declined because a human had already resolved the thread or it was internal-engineering discussion, leaving nothing to grade. This leaves 192 answered pairs (Table 5 ), the set used throughout, spanning live triage (agent responded in real time) and retrospective re-triage of historically resolved tickets; the human responses come from the original resolution, written without knowledge that an agent comparison would later occur.
blocks.zh: 经过过滤后,我们进一步排除了7个非答题,即代理人正确拒绝了,因为一个人已经解决了线程,或者是内部工程的讨论,没有留下任何分级。 由此留下192对答对(表5),即整个使用的套装,跨越直播分解(代理实时回复)和追溯回溯历史解析的门票;人类的回答来自原始解析,写作时不知道会发生代理比较.

blocks.en: Table 5: Population inclusion flow. The 499 triaged tickets measure deployment scale and are a distinct population; the scored-evaluation set is built separately from the 333 pairs that received both an agent and a human response (live and retrospective), filtered and stripped of seven non-answers to the 192 answered pairs.
blocks.zh: 表5:人口包容性流动。 499个三进制票衡量部署规模,是独特的人群;得分评价套与333对既收到代理,又收到人反应(活和回),过滤并剥离7个不回答192对的对.

blocks.en: Three-judge unanimity varies by class: 79% of assertions the panel labels correct and 87% of unverifiable ones are unanimous, but only 39% of incorrect ones—the judges disagree most about what counts as a contradiction. This is why agreement on the verifiable subset ( κ = 0.50 \kappa=0.50{} ) is lower than the overall κ = 0.73 \kappa=0.73{} .
blocks.zh: 三位法官的一致程度因类别而异:79%的评议正确,87%的评议无法核实,但只有39%的评议不正确——法官对什么是矛盾意见分歧最大。 因此,关于可核查子集(κ=0.50\kappa=0.50××)的协议低于总体κ=0.73\kappa=0.73×××.

blocks.en: C.2 Judge Panel
blocks.zh: C.2 法官小组

blocks.en: All automated evaluation uses a panel of three judges ( Models B, C, D ) drawn from three different model families , none of them the family of the agent’s generation model ( Model A ); all model names are anonymized. Each item is scored by all three at temperature 0 (for reproducibility), and we report the majority verdict with inter-judge agreement (Fleiss’ κ \kappa ). We call two models the same family when they come from the same developer. A fourth judge ( Model E ) from the same family as Model A is run only as a probe. Prior work documents self- and family-preference in LLM judges ( Spiliopoulou et al. 2025 ; Zheng et al. 2023 ) , so we keep Model E out of every headline number. Table 6 compares its verdicts with the panel’s. The probe does not consistently favor the agent. On correctness it is more decisive in both directions. On usefulness it prefers the agent less often than the panel does. On before/after it prefers the post-repair answer more often.
blocks.zh: 所有自动评价都使用由三个不同的模式家庭组成的三人评委小组(模式B、C、D),其中没有一个是代理商一代模式的家族(模式A);所有模式名称都是匿名的。 每件物品在0度温度(可复制性)下均得分, 我们称两个模型来自同一个开发商时是同一个家庭. 第四位法官(型号E)来自与型号A相同的家庭,仅作为探测器运行. 以往的工作文件是LLM法官的自我和家庭偏好(Spiliopoulou等人)。 2025; 郑等人 2023),因此,我们在所有头条号码中都保留了模型E. 表6将其判决与小组的裁决作了比较。 探测器并不一贯喜欢这个特工 在正确性方面,这在两个方面都更具决定性。 在用途方面,它比面板更倾向于代理人。 在它之前/之后,它更喜欢修复后的答案。

blocks.en: Table 6: Same-family probe (Model E) against the cross-family panel majority. The panel has no majority on 6 assertions.
blocks.zh: 表6:针对跨家庭小组多数的同族调查(模式E)。 小组对6项主张没有多数意见。

blocks.en: C.3 Factual Correctness
blocks.zh: C.3 事实正确性

blocks.en: The factual correctness evaluation operates at assertion granularity through a two-pass pipeline:
blocks.zh: 事实正确性评价是通过两条通道进行的:

blocks.en: The judge receives the agent’s full response and extracts every discrete factual claim as a short, self-contained statement. Claims include causal attributions, specific values or configurations, references to documentation, diagnostic conclusions, and procedural recommendations. Greetings, opinions, hedged language, and questions back to the user are excluded. The prompt template is provided in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 法官收到代理人的完整答复,并摘录了作为简短、自足陈述的每一项独立的事实主张。 索赔包括因果关系、具体价值或配置、参考文件、诊断结论和程序建议。 问候,意见,套期语言, 和回问用户。 快速模板见附录E。

blocks.en: Each extracted assertion is verified by the panel against the human’s response as the single authoritative reference, under a mutually-exclusive rule: • incorrect — the reference addresses the claim and contradicts it; • correct — the reference addresses the claim and is consistent with it; • unverifiable — the reference does not address the claim.
blocks.zh: 小组根据一条相互排斥的规则,对照人类的唯一权威参考,对每一项摘录的断言进行核实:不正确——参考涉及索赔,与之相矛盾;正确——参考涉及索赔,并与索赔一致;不可核实——参考不涉及索赔。

blocks.en: incorrect — the reference addresses the claim and contradicts it;
blocks.zh: 不正确——该参考涉及索赔要求,与之相矛盾;

blocks.en: correct — the reference addresses the claim and is consistent with it;
blocks.zh: 正确——参考涉及索赔,并与索赔一致;

blocks.en: unverifiable — the reference does not address the claim.
blocks.zh: 无法核实——该提及不涉及索赔。

blocks.en: Silence is unverifiable , never correct : a claim is labeled correct only when the reference actually speaks to it and agrees. This closes an overlap in the earlier single-judge version, where “not contradicted” and “not addressed” could both apply to the same claim, and it is why the unverifiable share is large—many terse human resolutions do not address the agent’s specific claims. We report accuracy over verifiable assertions and over all assertions, both labeled, rather than a single headline that hides the denominator. The evaluation runs over the 192 answered pairs.
blocks.zh: 沉默是无法核实的,永远不能纠正的:只有在提到它并表示同意时,索赔才被贴上正确的标签。 这与先前的单一法官版本有重叠之处,其中 " 不矛盾 " 和 " 未处理 " 既可适用于同一索赔要求,也正因为如此,无法核实的份额很大 -- -- 许多人的决议没有涉及代理人的具体索赔要求。 我们报告准确性高于可核实的断言和所有被标注的断言,而不是一个掩盖分母的头条。 评估超过了192对回答。

blocks.en: C.4 Usefulness (Pairwise Preference)
blocks.zh: C.4 实用性(对等优先)

blocks.en: Each of the 192 pairs is presented to the panel in blinded A/B format—the ticket, then “Response A” and “Response B”—with the agent’s response assigned to A or B at random per ticket (by a hash of the ticket id, so the assignment is fixed and reproducible). The judges score three dimensions: • Actionability — which response better equips the reader to take the correct next action? • Completeness — which covers more relevant diagnostic information? • Overall preference — which would you prefer to send as the official answer?
blocks.zh: 192对每对都是用盲A/B格式——即罚单,然后是 " 答复A " 和 " 答复B " ——向面板呈交,代理商的回应是按每张罚单随机分配给A或B的(通过票号的散列,因此任务是固定的和可复制的)。 法官得分分为三个方面: 行动能力——哪一种反应使读者能够更好地采取正确的下一步行动? • 完整性——涵盖更相关的诊断信息? · 总体偏好——你希望哪一个作为正式答复发出?

blocks.en: Actionability — which response better equips the reader to take the correct next action?
blocks.zh: 可操作性——何种反应使读者能够更好地采取正确的下一步行动?

blocks.en: Completeness — which covers more relevant diagnostic information?
blocks.zh: 完整性——涵盖更相关的诊断信息?

blocks.en: Overall preference — which would you prefer to send as the official answer?
blocks.zh: 总体偏好——你想把哪一个作为正式答复?

blocks.en: For each dimension a judge chooses “A better”, “B better”, or “tie”; the reported verdict is the cross-family majority on overall preference, with Fleiss’ κ \kappa .
blocks.zh: 对于每个方面,法官都选择“更好”、“更好”或“tie”;所报告的判决是家庭在总体偏好上占多数,Fleiss的“xkappa” 。

blocks.en: Because pairwise preference tracks response length, we report the length-comparable subset (the two responses within a 2 × 2\times length ratio) alongside the full set. A separate coverage pass asks, for each pair, whether the agent raised a correct material point the human omitted, and whether the human raised one the agent omitted.
blocks.zh: 由于双向偏好音轨响应长度,我们报告长度可比较子集(在2×2\times长度比内的两个响应)与全集. 单次覆盖通行证每对都询问代理人是否提出了人类省略的正确物质点,以及人类是否提出了代理人省略的一点。

blocks.en: C.5 Self-Improvement (Before/After)
blocks.zh: C.5 自我改进(前后)

blocks.en: Confidence is the triage’s own self-reported label; “not high-confidence” ( = = medium / low ) covers 40 of the 231 matched before/after pairs (the rest high , with little room to improve; 1 unlabeled), of which 5 lack a stored earlier answer—leaving the 35 pairs we compare against a later re-answer produced under the updated documentation. The comparison is blinded: the panel sees the two answers as A/B without being told which came first, and reports which better resolves the ticket. We corroborate causal attribution against the documentation repository’s revision history—for the gaps the loop tagged, the commit that updates the answering documentation postdates the gap’s discovery—rather than relying on the tracker’s “fixed” flag.
blocks.zh: 自信是团队自己自报的标签; " 不高自信 " (== = 中/低)涵盖231对中前后配对的40对(其余高,几乎没有改进的余地;1个无标签),其中5对缺乏储存较早的答案 -- -- 与后来根据更新的文件所作的重新回答相比较。 比较是盲目的:小组将两个答案视为A/B,而没有被告知哪个答案是第一位的,以及更好地解决罚单的报告。 我们用文件存放处的修订历史来证实因果关系——对于所标注的漏洞,更新答复文件的承诺是在发现漏洞之后,而不是依赖追踪者的 " 固定 " 旗帜。

blocks.en: Appendix D Self-Improvement Case Studies
blocks.zh: 附录D 自我改进案例研究

blocks.en: We illustrate the self-improvement loop with two examples from deployment—demonstrations of the loop operating end to end, chosen for clarity rather than as a representative sample. They show both the simplest case (a single knowledge base addition suffices) and the full end-to-end pipeline (gap surfaced from customer interaction, fix drafted autonomously, merged via code review).
blocks.zh: 我们用部署的两个例子——循环运行结束到结束的示范——来说明自我改进的循环,选择这个循环是为了明确而不是作为代表性的样本。 它们既显示最简单的案例(一个单一的知识库补充就足够),也显示完整的端到端管道(从客户互动中浮出水面,自动固定起草,通过代码审查合并).

blocks.en: D.1 Anatomy of a Triage Response
blocks.zh: D.1 三角形反应的解剖

blocks.en: Every triage produces a structured record whose fields feed the gap-detection loop directly. A stylized example (the ramp-schedule scenario of Section 1 ): Ticket. “Why does the dashboard show a launch date earlier than when I created the experiment?” • response: “The date shown is when traffic allocation began under the ramp schedule, not when the experiment was created…” • confidence: high • sources_cited: [ramp-schedule guide §2; experiment-lifecycle overview] • gap_found: true gap_type: ambiguous target_doc: experiment-lifecycle overview • suggested_fix: clarify that the displayed “launch date” refers to ramp start The confidence field gates the self-improvement selection ( Section 3.4 ); gap_found , gap_type , target_doc , and suggested_fix feed the Documentator and the improvement tracker.
blocks.zh: 每次分解都会产生一个结构化的记录,其字段直接反馈到漏洞-检测循环. 平面图例(第1节的坡道时间表方案):票. “为什么仪表板显示的发射日期比我创建实验时早?” • 答复:“所示日期是根据坡道时间表开始的交通分配,而不是进行试验时......”。 • 信心:高 来源_引用:[ramp-chedule指南§2;实验-生命周期概览] 差距_发现:真正的差距_类型:模棱两可的目标_doc:实验-生命周期概览_建议_fix:澄清显示的“发射日期”是指坡道启动 置信字段为自改进选择(第3.4节); 漏洞_发现, 漏洞_类型, 目标_doc, 并建议_fix feed the Documentator and the 改进 tracker.

blocks.zh: 回应: “所示日期是根据坡道时间表开始的交通分配,而不是试验创建时...... “

blocks.en: confidence: high
blocks.zh: 信心:高

blocks.en: sources_cited: [ramp-schedule guide §2; experiment-lifecycle overview]
blocks.zh: 引用源_引用:[ramp-schedule 指南§2;实验-生命周期概览]

blocks.en: D.2 Case 1: Knowledge Base Addition
blocks.zh: D.2 案例1:知识库

blocks.en: A user asks why the analysis engine’s variance estimates are conservative relative to an alternative estimator. The agent retrieves all available documentation but finds no authoritative source addressing this specific comparison. It responds with low confidence:
blocks.zh: 一个用户问,为什么分析引擎的差异估计相对于替代估计数据来说是保守的。 该代理人检索了所有可用的文件,但没有找到处理这一具体比较的权威性来源。 它的反应不自信:

blocks.en: “I cannot confirm from available documentation why the variance estimates differ between the two systems. Based on what I can find, both use standard estimators, but I do not have a source that explains the conservatism you are observing. Flagging this for expert input.”
blocks.zh: “我无法从现有文件中确认这两个系统之间的差异估计数为何不同。 根据我所能找到的, 都使用标准估计器, 但我没有来源来解释你所看到的保守主义。 标注此为专家输入 。 “

blocks.en: The structured learning step classifies this as a documentation gap of type missing : the topic has no knowledge base coverage.
blocks.zh: 结构化的学习步骤将它归类为缺少类型的文献空白:这个话题没有知识基础覆盖.

blocks.en: A technical paper explaining the finite-population regression variance bound—and why the engine’s estimates are conservative by construction—is added to the knowledge base. No agent code or prompt changes are made.
blocks.zh: 一份解释有限人口回归差异的技术文件被添加到知识库中, 没有代理代码或即时更改.

blocks.en: On the next occurrence of a related question, the agent retrieves the newly added paper, cites it directly, and provides a definitive answer with high confidence:
blocks.zh: 在下一次出现相关问题时,特工取回了新添加的纸张,直接引用,并以高度的自信给出了明确的答案:

blocks.en: “The variance estimates are conservative by design. The engine uses a finite-population regression variance bound [citing specific paper, §3.2] which is provably conservative relative to the Neyman estimator used by the alternative system. This is not a bug—it reflects a deliberate choice to avoid anti-conservative inference in finite samples.”
blocks.zh: “差异估计数按设计是保守的。 该引擎使用一个有限的-人口回归变量绑定[引用特定纸张,§3.2],相对于替代系统使用的Neyman估计器来说,该变量显然是保守的. 这不是虫子——它反映了在有限样品中避免反保守推论的蓄意选择。 “

blocks.en: The self-improvement step reports: “No documentation gap found.”
blocks.zh: 自我改进步骤报告:“没有发现文件空白。 “

blocks.en: The entire loop—from gap detection to resolution—required only a knowledge base update. No retraining, no prompt modification, and no code change. The agent’s behavior improved solely because its retrieval source improved.
blocks.zh: 整个循环——从差距探测到解析——只需要更新知识库。 不进行再培训,不立即修改,也不改变代码. 代理人的行为改善完全是因为其检索来源改善.

blocks.en: D.3 Case 2: Full Pipeline (Ticket to Merged Fix)
blocks.zh: D.3 案例2:全管道(连接到合并修复)

blocks.en: This case illustrates the complete system operating end-to-end, including a subtlety: the agent initially fails to recognize a gap, and customer feedback is needed to surface it.
blocks.zh: 这个案例说明了完整的系统运行端对端,包括一个微妙之处:代理商最初没有识别到一个漏洞,需要客户反馈才能浮出水面.

blocks.en: A user asks whether a foundational technical document is outdated because it does not mention a recently introduced methodology. The user has independently found two related documents and wants to understand how the three relate.
blocks.zh: 一个用户询问基础技术文件是否过时,因为它没有提到最近采用的方法。 用户已独立找到两个相关文件,并想知道这三个文件有何关联.

blocks.en: The agent correctly explains the relationship between the three documents—the foundational document remains authoritative, and the newer documents extend (rather than supersede) it. Confidence is high. The structured learning step reports “No documentation gap found,” reasoning that the information exists across the three documents and the separation is an organizational choice.
blocks.zh: 代理人正确地解释了这三种文件之间的关系——基础文件仍然具有权威性,而较新的文件会扩展(而不是取代)它。 信心高涨. 结构化的学习步骤报告“没有发现文件空白”,理由是这三份文件中都有信息,而离职是一个组织选择。

blocks.en: The user replies suggesting that a cross-reference note in the foundational document would prevent future users from going on “the same scavenger hunt.” This reframes the issue: the gap is not missing content but missing navigational structure between related documents.
blocks.zh: 用户答复说,基础文件中的交叉参考说明将防止未来用户进行“同样的扫荡者狩猎”。 这重新定义了这个问题:相关文件之间没有缺少内容,而是缺少导航结构。

blocks.en: On re-triage with the new correspondence, the agent recognizes the customer’s confusion as the gap signal itself. It writes a structured entry to the improvement tracker: type ambiguous , target document identified, suggested fix is a cross-reference paragraph.
blocks.zh: 在与新信件联系时,代理商承认客户的混乱是空白信号本身。 它在改进跟踪器上写了一个结构化条目:类型模糊不清,目标文件被识别,建议修补是一个交叉引用的段落.

blocks.en: The Documentator agent reads the target document, drafts a “Related documents” paragraph with proper citations to both companion papers, and submits the fix as a code review.
blocks.zh: 记录员代理人阅读目标文件,起草一个“相关文件”段落,同时适当引用两份配套文件,并提交固定文件作为代码审查。

blocks.en: The human reviewer approves the change. The foundational document now cross-references its companion papers, preventing the navigational confusion that generated the original ticket.
blocks.zh: 人文评审员批准变更. 基础文档现在交叉引用其伴生论文,防止了产生原始票的导航混乱.

blocks.en: D.4 Discussion
blocks.zh: D.4 讨论情况

blocks.en: These two cases illustrate complementary aspects of the self-improvement loop:
blocks.zh: 这两个案例说明了自我改进循环的互补方面:

blocks.en: • Case 1 demonstrates that the loop requires no retraining—only knowledge base expansion. Most gaps are of this kind (missing content): the system identifies what is missing, a human adds the documentation, and the agent benefits on subsequent queries. • Case 2 demonstrates the system’s ability to learn from customer feedback as well as from its own failures. The agent’s initial triage was correct, yet the customer’s response revealed a usability gap invisible to a purely content-focused analysis. It also shows the full autonomous pipeline: from gap detection through drafted fix to merged code review, with the human’s role shifted from author to reviewer.
blocks.zh: · 案例1表明,循环不需要再培训——只扩大知识库。 大部分空白都属于此类(缺失内容):系统识别缺失的内容,一个人添加文档,代理商对后续查询有利. • 支助 案例2表明,该系统有能力从客户反馈和自身失败中学习。 该代理最初的分解是正确的,然而客户的反应揭示了一个纯粹以内容为重点的分析所看不到的可用性差距. 它还显示了完全自主的管道:从发现漏洞到起草的固定程序到合并代码审查,人类的作用从作者转移到审查者。

blocks.en: Appendix E Judge Prompt Templates
blocks.zh: 附录E 法官提示模板

blocks.en: We provide the exact prompt templates used in our LLM-as-judge evaluation for reproducibility. All evaluations use the judge model ( Model B ) at temperature 0. Each prompt is shown as delivered to the model, with placeholders (in braces) filled at runtime from the evaluation pair.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了我们作为法官的LLM评估中使用的准确的即时模板,以供复制。 所有评价在温度下使用评委模型(模式B) 零点 每个提示显示为交付给模型,在运行时从评价对中填充占位符。

blocks.en: E.1 Factual Correctness: Assertion Extraction
blocks.zh: E.1 事实正确性:取证

blocks.en: This prompt is applied once per agent response. It receives the full response text and returns a list of discrete factual claims. The key design choice is the explicit exclusion list (greetings, opinions, hedges, questions)—without it, the judge tends to extract subjective statements that cannot be meaningfully verified.
blocks.zh: 一旦每个毒剂反应,即适用这一提示。 它收到了答复全文,并退回了一份单独的事实索赔清单。 关键的设计选择是明确的排除列表(发声,意见,套期,问题)——没有它,法官倾向于提取无法进行有意义的核实的主观陈述.

blocks.en: You are extracting factual claims from a technical support response. List every concrete factual assertion the response makes—things that are either true or false, verifiable against documentation or system behavior. Extract each factual claim as a short, self-contained statement. Include: • Causal claims (“X happens because Y”) • Specific values, thresholds, or configurations mentioned • References to specific documentation, tools, or system behavior • Diagnostic claims (“the root cause is X”) • Procedural claims (“to fix this, do X then Y”) Do NOT extract: greetings or politeness, opinions or subjective assessments, questions asked back to the customer, hedging language (“this might be”, “possibly”). Output format: respond with ONLY a JSON array of strings (no markdown, no commentary): [“assertion 1”, “assertion 2”, “assertion 3”, …] If the response contains no verifiable factual claims, return: []
blocks.zh: 您正在从技术支持回复中提取事实指控。 列出答复提出的每一项具体的事实断言——是真实的还是虚假的,可以对照文件或系统行为加以核实。 将每项事实索赔摘录为一份简短、自足的陈述。 • 提及具体文件、工具或系统行为(“根源是X”) 不要摘录:问候或礼貌、意见或主观评估、向客户提问、套期保值语(“这可能是”、“可能是”)。 输出格式: 仅用 JSON 系列字符串( 无标记, 无注释) 响应 : [“ 编号 1”、“ 编号 2”、“ 编号 3 ” ] 如果答复中不含可核实的事实性索赔,则返回:

blocks.en: Causal claims (“X happens because Y”)
blocks.zh: 因果关系索赔(“X发生于Y”)

blocks.en: Specific values, thresholds, or configurations mentioned
blocks.zh: 提及的具体值、阈值或配置

blocks.en: References to specific documentation, tools, or system behavior
blocks.zh: 参考文件、工具或系统行为

blocks.en: Diagnostic claims (“the root cause is X”)
blocks.zh: 诊断性索赔(“根源是X”)

blocks.en: Procedural claims (“to fix this, do X then Y”)
blocks.zh: 程序性申诉(“纠正这种情况,先做X,然后做Y”)

blocks.en: E.2 Factual Correctness: Assertion Verification
blocks.zh: E.2 事实正确性:验证

blocks.en: This prompt is applied once per extracted assertion. It receives the assertion, the original ticket context, and the human’s response (treated as reference answer). The three labels are mutually exclusive: correct requires the reference to actually address the claim and agree with it; incorrect requires a direct factual conflict; unverifiable is used when the reference is silent on the claim. Silence is never correct .
blocks.zh: 每一抽取的断言一适用这一提示。 它收到断言、原始票证和人类的反应(作为参考答复)。 这三个标签是相互排斥的:正确性要求参照实际处理索赔并与之一致;不正确性要求直接发生事实冲突;当参照对索赔保持沉默时使用不可核实. 沉默永远不对

blocks.en: You are verifying whether a factual claim made in a support response is correct, given a reference answer from a domain expert. The claim: “ { assertion } ” Context — the customer’s question: Title: { ticket_title } { ticket_description } Reference answer (from the domain expert who resolved this ticket): { ic_response } Determine whether the claim is: • “incorrect” — the reference addresses the claim and contradicts it • “correct” — the reference addresses the claim and is consistent with it • “unverifiable” — the reference does not address the claim Important: the three labels are mutually exclusive. “correct” requires the reference to actually speak to the claim and agree; if the reference is silent on the point, the label is “unverifiable”, never “correct”. Output format: respond with ONLY a JSON object (no markdown, no commentary): { “verdict”: “correct | | incorrect | | unverifiable”, “rationale”: “1 sentence explanation” }
blocks.zh: 您正在核实在支持性答复中所作的事实性声称是否正确, 提供域专家的参考答复。 索赔:“{主张}” 背景 - 客户的问题: 标题:{票_标题}{票_说明}参考答案(来自解决本票问题的域专家): { ic_答复} 确定索赔是否为: · “不正确”—— 提及涉及索赔并与之相矛盾 · “更正”—— 提及涉及索赔并与其一致 · “不可核实”—— 提及不涉及索赔 重要的: 三个标签是相互排斥的。 “更正”要求实际提及索赔并表示同意;如果提及这一点时保持沉默,标签是“不可核实的”,绝不是“更正”。 输出格式: 仅用 JSON 对象( 无标记, 无注释) 响应 : { “校正” :“ 正确 QQ 错误 QQ 无法验证 ” , “ 合理 ” :“ 1 句解释 ” )

blocks.en: “incorrect” — the reference addresses the claim and contradicts it
blocks.zh: “不正确”——该提及涉及索赔,与之相矛盾

blocks.en: “correct” — the reference addresses the claim and is consistent with it
blocks.zh: “更正”——提及索赔,并与索赔一致

blocks.en: “unverifiable” — the reference does not address the claim
blocks.zh: “无法核实的”——该提法不涉及索赔

blocks.en: E.3 Pairwise Preference
blocks.zh: E.3 对等优先

blocks.en: This prompt is applied once per evaluation pair. It receives the ticket and two blinded responses (A and B, with assignment determined by the counterbalancing configuration). The key design choices are: (a) three independent sub-questions that decompose preference into actionability, completeness, and overall judgment; (b) forced ternary (A/B/tie) with no numeric scoring; and (c) a mandatory rationale per dimension to encourage deliberation before the verdict.
blocks.zh: 这种提示每对评价一适用一次。 它收到罚单和两个失明的反应(A和B,任务由反平衡配置决定). 关键的设计选择是:(a) 将偏好分为可操作性、完整性和总体判断的三个独立的子问题;(b) 无数字分数的强迫三重性(A/B/tie);以及(c) 每个维度的强制性理由,以鼓励在判决前进行审议。

blocks.en: You are evaluating two responses to a technical support ticket. Both responses attempt to help the customer resolve their issue. Your job is to compare them on three specific criteria. The support ticket: Title: { ticket_title } { ticket_description } Response A: { response_a } Response B: { response_b } Answer each question independently. For each, choose exactly one of: “A” (Response A is better), “B” (Response B is better), or “tie” (both are roughly equivalent on this criterion). Q1—Actionability: if you were the on-call engineer receiving one of these responses as guidance, which would better equip you to take the correct next action without further research? Q2—Completeness: which response covers more of the relevant diagnostic information for this specific ticket? Consider: root cause identification, relevant context, and next steps. Q3—Overall preference: setting aside formatting and style, which response would you prefer to send to the customer as the official answer to their ticket? Output format: respond with ONLY a JSON object (no markdown, no commentary): { “actionability”: { “choice”: “A | | B | | tie”, “rationale”: “1 sentence why” } , “completeness”: { … } , “overall”: { … }}
blocks.zh: 您正在评估对一张技术支持单的两次答复。 这两项答复都试图帮助客户解决问题。 你的工作是根据三个具体标准来比较它们. 支持票:标题:{票_标题}{票_说明}回应A:{回应_a}回应B:{回应_b}每个问题独立回答. 对于每一个,从“A”(答复A更好)、“B”(答复B更好)或“tie”(两者在这一标准上大致相当)。 问题1——可操作性:如果你是作为指导收到这些答复之一的待命工程师,那么,如果你没有进一步研究,就能更好地采取正确的下一步行动? 问题2——完成性:哪些反应涵盖了这个具体罚单的更多相关诊断信息? 考虑:确定根源、相关背景和下一步。 Q3 — 总体偏好: 撇开格式和风格, 你更愿意向客户发送哪些回应作为他们票的官方答案? 输出格式: 仅用 JSON 对象( 无标记, 无评注) 响应 : { “可诉性” : { “选择” : “A Q Q Q B Q Q Q Q ” , “合理性” : “1句为什么” , “完成性” : {... } , “总体” :{...}
